name: Environment managers
description: Version-manager tool requests and direnv state, read from declarative files and the shell's own bookkeeping. Nothing is activated, trusted or sourced.

provenance.author: notMyShell
provenance.notes: First-party pack shipped with NMSh. Independent implementation.

modules.label: mise / asdf
modules.description: Tools the nearest mise.toml or .tool-versions requests (never runs mise or asdf).

modules.label: direnv
modules.description: Whether direnv loaded this workspace's .envrc (never reads or sources it).
